helper.cloneSafety: preflight of all 20 clones before any mutation; refuses on a non-plain clone, wrong origin or alternates, an operation in progress, attached linked worktrees, any modified/untracked/ignored entry, any other ref or detached HEAD holding clone-local commits, and any existing clone whose (base, review-head) ids are not exactly a pair recorded for that area in pairs-preliminary.json or a final pairs.json committed at the source, or in --out-dir/pairs.json from a completed build (message prefix and parent shape are still checked but never prove ownership; malformed or wrong-status pair evidence fails the run); drag-a and drag-b are never touched
helper.stoppedBuild: pair ids are recorded only when all 20 pairs pass; a build that stops midway names the stopped area and those already rebuilt, and the next preflight refuses every clone it changed. Recovery is manual: confirm the clone holds no review work, remove it, rerun (it is rebuilt as absent). No journal
